removal_note: Private notes, generated Python cache and two raw profiler traces are archived outside the repository. Machine metadata in raw traces is not publication evidence; measurement summaries remain. No runtime state databases, lock files, identity directories, copied packages, keys or credentials were found in the publication tree.

sanitization.private_identity_source: Private matrix environment file parsed in memory; nonempty values fixed-string scanned without printing them.
judgement_calls: Generic host-a labels are experiment identifiers, not machine names; retained to preserve evidence links.
Four-component package versions are version identifiers, not network addresses; retained unchanged. Socket-example addresses in dependency descriptions were replaced with loopback addresses.
Package metadata and generated model answers are evidence or upstream package documentation, not generated input documents; retained.
Two raw profiler traces were archived rather than publishing machine metadata embedded in trace events.
Only text strings were scrubbed in retained JSON/JSONL; every numeric leaf was compared against the untouched archive.

numeric_evidence.scope: Every numeric JSON/JSONL leaf, including array position and dictionary key path; booleans excluded. Strings containing scrubbed paths or addresses are not numeric measurements. Archived profiler trace event values are excluded.

input_deduplication.regeneration_method: Load the pinned local tokenizer using transformers==5.19.0 with jinja2; call long-depth.py prepare(tokenizer, capyctl_bench, token_count, int(seed)) for every manifest row; compare token_count and hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(messages, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest() with each recorded value.
input_deduplication.note: Full generated long-context messages are absent from both the incoming tree and untouched archive. Existing manifests retain seeds, exact token counts and message hashes. No new document-to-reference conversion was needed. All 189 distinct messages were regenerated locally and matched their recorded exact token counts and byte-level message hashes. This CPU/offline publication audit does not qualify an engine.
